info.name: Blurchat - Blur Whatsapp Web Chat
info.description:
A simple CSS stylesheet that will blur the WhatsApp chats. It will increase your privacy so the people cannot read your text messages. Good if you are using WhatsApp web in office.
You can also download the extension from https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/blurchat/nhndojajncibjgdmihadlejpbpngkmkf
